_note: The critical effect pool (DESIGN.md §3). Journal-first: an entry with id, name, journal, locations, damageTypes and severity is COMPLETE and fully usable — the flow resolves it, names it, links the journal, and stops. `outcomes` is optional, added entry by entry after phase 5, and no part of the engine assumes it exists. Populated by the content track; `game.criticalEffects.lint()` reports coverage.

_schema.id: stable slug — the join key for everything
_schema.name: display name
_schema.locations: array, inclusive: head | torso | arm | leg | wing | tail
_schema.anatomy: optional array gate: humanoid | beast | aberrant. Omit = all
_schema.weight: optional positive draw weight within its bucket
_schema.save: optional { type: fort|ref|will, dc: formula, onSuccess: [...] } — onSuccess must be non-empty; a save mitigates, it never negates
